pages.title: Quick start: your first class website
pages.question: How do I get from nothing to a class website, without any account?
pages.about: From an empty folder to a first class website deployed to a folder on this Mac and opened in the browser, with no account.
steps: What you need: a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 15; no account for the first site; an assistant is optional (link github-education, inside an {{assistant}} run)
Download Plantoir from plantoir.app and drag it into Applications
Open it and choose an empty folder as your working folder (Choose Folder…, then Set Up This Folder)
New Course or Club opens by itself once the folder is set up. The first time, a line at the foot of the sidebar says Plantoir is getting this Mac ready; carry on, nothing needs waiting for
Type the course code and keep Pre-populate course with example content on if it is offered
In the same sheet's Deploying part, set Deploy to: A folder on this Mac, press Choose… and pick an empty folder; Create Course is refused until a folder is chosen
Select Section 1 in the sidebar and press Preview; read the site in the window
Press Deploy. A ready-made course ships every class published and dated across the semester, so Plantoir asks about classes dated later: leave them ticked or untick some (link later-classes)
Press Open in Browser. The site opens in your browser, served from the folder (#850; write after #850 merges)
